name: Ready frontier across task, background run and wait
steps: Submit a graph with independent background and date steps and a dependent code task through the installed manager tool
Read the real skill catalog in the background and save its result
Observe the date without reserving worker capacity
Release the dependent worker only after both predecessors land
Observe a committed worker result, merge, QA, deployment and runtime verification
Restart Core and read the same graph without repeating background or worker effects
